description: This file implements a Flutter widget for the reviews and testimonials screen, allowing users to view existing reviews and submit new ones. It manages state for user input, displays review data from a provider, and handles UI interactions.

classes.name: ReviewsScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the reviews and testimonials screen.

classes.name: _ReviewsScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the reviews screen's dynamic data, user interactions, and UI updates.

methods.description: Initializes the state, loads reviews, and sets up the widget.

methods.description: Constructs the UI widget tree for the reviews screen, displaying reviews and input controls.
